policy_prompt_for_subgoal: Start every episode in A (press the first button). Apply the first matching rule, after updating memory for this step: 1. If buttons_pressed is 0: A. 2. If buttons_pressed is 1: B. 3. If the scene at this decision step shows a container 'held in the gripper': D (put down the container). 4. If buttons_pressed is 2, nothing is held, and picked_colors is empty: C, pointing at the memory position (<color>_container) of the FIRST cube color named in the goal instruction (the one after 'hiding the'). Use the remembered container position, not the cube's original spot. 5. If buttons_pressed is 2, nothing is held, picked_colors has one entry, and the goal names a second cube ('another container hiding the ...'): C, pointing at the memory position of that SECOND color. This is the container that has not been lifted yet; do not point at the one just put down. 6. If every cube named in the goal is already in picked_colors and nothing is held: the task is done; answer D. Fallback: if the needed color's memory position is unknown, point C at the container nearest that cube's last known position; if no rule fits at all, answer the next unfinished item in goal order (A, B, C, D).

fields.name: buttons_pressed
fields.description: Carried-in count plus 1 if any execution frame shown at this step says a button 'is pressed down'; otherwise the carried-in count. Start at 0. e.g. 1

fields.name: green_container
fields.description: [y, x] of the container hiding the green cube. If a frame shows the green cube uncovered and no containers, write the cube's position. When containers appear, take the one standing on the carried-in green position. Then follow that container through the frames shown: match each container to the nearest container in the previous frame; during a button press two containers glide around each other and finish swapped, so after the press the green container sits where the other moving container started. Write its position in the last frame shown. If the green cube is exposed by lifting its container, write the exposed cube's position. Start with the cube position seen at the first step. e.g. [109, 126]

fields.name: red_container
fields.description: [y, x] of the container hiding the red cube, kept exactly as green_container: cube position when visible, then the container that covered it, followed frame to frame (two movers during a press swap places), written at the last frame shown. e.g. [82, 152]

fields.name: blue_container
fields.description: [y, x] of the container hiding the blue cube, kept exactly as green_container: cube position when visible, then the container that covered it, followed frame to frame (two movers during a press swap places), written at the last frame shown. e.g. [102, 79]

fields.name: picked_colors
fields.description: Carried-in list; append the color of the cube that appears beneath a container shown 'held in the gripper' among this step's frames, if that color is not already in the list. Start empty. e.g. ["green"]
